name: zennodroid-mcp
description: Official MCP servers for ZennoDroid: read and edit projects, run and monitor tasks, control Android devices. Requires ZennoDroid 2.6.1+ on Windows. The servers are local executables: download them from the repository releases and start each one with an API key before connecting. ZennoDroid's product API and MCP ports are the ZennoPoster ones shifted by +10, so start MCP.ProjectMaker with --urls http://localhost:6217 --ProjectMaker:BaseUrl=http://localhost:5309/api/v1 and MCP.ZennoPoster with --urls http://localhost:6220 --ZennoPoster:BaseUrl=http://localhost:5310/api/v1; MCP.Android is ZennoDroid-only and needs neither.
